jobs.name: r1
lines: Think of a number from one to ten. Got it? Don't tell me.
Now take away the number you first thought of.
Your answer is... five! Am I right?
Here's the secret. Your number disappears, so everyone ends on five.

jobs.name: r2
lines: Pick any three-digit number. Like seven three two. The first and last digits must be different.
Take the smaller from the bigger. Four nine five.
Now reverse that. Five nine four.
Try it with your own number. You get one thousand and eighty-nine every time. Comment your number!

jobs.name: r3
lines: Take the six. Times the next number, seven. Forty-two.
Then stick twenty-five on the end.
Four thousand two hundred and twenty-five!

jobs.name: r4
lines: Four hundred and fifty-seven, plus three hundred and eighty-six.
Go left to right. Four hundred plus three hundred is seven hundred.
Fifty plus eighty is a hundred and thirty. So eight hundred and thirty.
Your turn: six hundred and twenty-nine plus two hundred and eighty-four.
